description: Utility functions and constants for sanitizing, normalizing, and parsing MCP server and tool names, including encoding hyphens and constructing standardized function names.

methods.name: normalizeMcpToolName
methods.description: Converts underscore-separated MCP tool names to hyphen-separated format, preserving encoded hyphens.

methods.name: isMcpTool
methods.description: Checks if a given tool name starts with the MCP prefix and separator.

methods.name: sanitizeMcpName
methods.description: Sanitizes a name for safe use in API function names, encoding hyphens as triple underscores.

methods.name: buildMcpToolName
methods.description: Constructs a full MCP tool function name from server and tool names, with length cap.

methods.name: decodeMcpName
methods.description: Decodes a sanitized name back to its original form by converting triple underscores to hyphens.

methods.name: parseMcpToolName
methods.description: Parses a full MCP tool name into server and tool names, decoding hyphens.
